pool org "Organisation"
  lane rd "R&D team"
    start idea "Idea identified"
    task research "Conduct initial research and feasibility studies"
    task draft "Draft design concepts"
    task select "Select a promising design"
    task build "Build a prototype"
    task test "Test the prototype"
    task collect "Collect feedback"
    xor refine "Refinement needed?"
    task refineproto "Refine the prototype"
    xor approved "Prototype approved?"
    end done "Prototype approved for further development"
    end discarded "Prototype discarded"

flow idea -> research -> draft -> select -> build -> test -> collect -> refine
flow refine -> refineproto "yes"
flow refineproto -> test
flow refine -> approved "no"
flow approved -> done "approved"
flow approved -> discarded "discarded"
